data.name: Brajesh
data.gender_notes: Brajesh is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Brajesh is a Sanskrit name derived from the words ‘Braja’ (a place of Lord Krishna) and ‘Ish’ (God). This name signifies one who is the lord of Braja or Lord Krishna himself. The name Brajesh carries the meaning “Lord of Braja” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Brajesh usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of braja and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name deeply rooted in the spiritual traditions of Hinduism, symbolizing devotion and connection to Lord Krishna.
data.etymology: Brajesh belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lord of Braja.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Brajesh total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

historical_references.reference: Brajesh Chakraborty, a Bengali poet and writer, was born in the late 19th century in what is now Bangladesh. He is best known for his poems that express longing for the lost homeland and the pain of partition.
historical_references.context: Brajesh Chakraborty's poetry reflects the emotional and cultural turmoil of the Bengali populace during the period of British colonial rule and the subsequent partition of Bengal and India.
